messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager — Elevated DNS resolution errors detected for georoute.example.com. Multiple edge probes showing intermittent NXDOMAIN/SERVFAIL and some stale CNAMEs. Affected regions: eu-west-1 and eu-north-1. Launch triage.
Priya: I'm seeing a pattern where responses alternate between the correct A record and an old CNAME that points to decommissioned-edge. TTLs for the geo records were unchanged but TTL propagation looks weird.
Dan: I ran `dig +trace georoute.example.com` from a few public resolvers. Results sometimes return the old CNAME then immediately SERVFAIL on retry. Example: `;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: SERVFAIL`
Emilio: No dns-config changes in last 4h on our side. Cloudflare reported a brief API rate-limiting event an hour ago when the docs pipeline did a burst; wondering if their authoritative cache/staging pushed inconsistent zone data.
Priya: Can we avoid a full NS flip? Ops runbook suggests: 1) reduce TTL to 20s, 2) temporarily switch routing policy for georoute to prefer eu-north-1, 3) enable health-check bypass. Who can do weights?
Emilio: I can change Route53 weights. Planning to set eu-west-1 weight->10, eu-north-1->90 and TTL->20. CLI (Route53):
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id ZABCDE --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"georoute.example.com","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"eu-north-1","Weight":90,"TTL":20,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"5.6.7.8"}]}},{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"georoute.example.com","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"eu-west-1","Weight":10,"TTL":20,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"9.8.7.6"}]}}]}'
```
Emilio: Pushed change now. Propagating.
Dan: After the weight change, I'm seeing more consistent A answers from eu-north-1. Client error rate in EU decreased from ~7% -> ~2% in the last 10m.
Priya: Good. I'm opening tickets: AWS case with details of inconsistent NS answers and Cloudflare support asking them to validate zone serial numbers and deploy logs.
AWS-Support-Bot: Case created: 9876543210. AWS will triage with Route53 engineering.
CS-Liaison: I'm drafting a customer-facing blurb: "We're investigating intermittent DNS failures impacting EU traffic. We've applied a temporary routing change to reduce impact and are working with DNS providers. No data was affected. Updates every 30 minutes." Feedback?
Priya: Add note: "We may revert TTL/routing once provider confirms stable serials." Also include targeted customers list (sent separately).
Emilio: Spotted a small batch of resolvers returning NXDOMAIN with EDNS0 errors. I'll add resolver-level probing and save traces.
Dan: Traces attached inline:
```
--- probe 1 eu-west-1 2026-03-15T11:05Z
query georoute.example.com -> CNAME old-edge.example.net
retry -> SERVFAIL
--- probe 2 eu-north-1 2026-03-15T11:07Z
query -> A 5.6.7.8
```
Priya: For the on-call handoff: I'm taking the next 45m to coordinate with AWS and Cloudflare and watch metrics. Emilio please continue resolving traces. Dan hold on alerts for DNS-facing errors.
CS-Liaison: Customers notified. One partner asked for a timeline for full rollback; we'll update them post-AWS confirmation.
Emilio: AWS responded: they see propagation anomalies in a small subset of authoritative nodes — escalated to Route53 engine team. They're investigating serial mismatch across POPs.
Dan: Once Route53 confirms stable state, we'll revert weights and TTL. Planning revert window in 90m if no regressions.
Priya: Posting interim status to infra-status page and to #customers-ops. Leaving incident open for follow-ups and postmortem.
IncidentBot: :warning: Severity set to S2. Paging remains active until handoff completed.
AWS-Support-Bot: Update on case 9876543210: Route53 engineers are rolling a fix to resync zone serials; ETA 40 minutes.
Priya: Acknowledged. I'll wait for confirmation before reverting. CS-Liaison please continue customer comms.
CS-Liaison: Will do. Next update in 20m or on major status change.
Dan: After partial resync observed at 11:42Z, DNS answers normalized in probes. Client error rate fell to ~0.6%.
Emilio: Rolling TTL/weight revert now: setting TTL back to 300 and restoring original weights.
Priya: Revert done. Monitoring for oscillation for 30m.
IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: Incident status changed to "mitigated" by Priya. Please file post-incident review with timeline, change ids, provider case numbers, and customer impact summary.
CS-Liaison: Customers updated with mitigation and promise of full RCA in follow-up.
Priya: Postmortem owner assigned: Priya. I'll compile timeline, include Route53 case 9876543210 and Cloudflare ticket 444-xyz, and schedule a review.
Emilio: All probe logs stored to /var/incidents/3791234567/.
Dan: Oncall handoff: Priya -> Emilio in 45m.
Priya: Handoff acknowledged. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
